title: Conditional Hilbert-space classification of Gromov--Hausdorff space
summary: A Lean formalization of the implication from five explicitly stated literature inputs to a homeomorphism between the ordinary Gromov--Hausdorff space of nonempty compact metric spaces and real square-summable sequences. The proof constructs invariant full-support probability assignments, finite dimensional local models, global AR domination and discrete approximation. The five literature inputs are assumptions, not theorems proved in this snapshot.

review.reason: Lean formalization of a conditional homeomorphism classification of Gromov–Hausdorff space.
